title: GAO-25-107126: Digital Surveillance — Potential Effects on Workers and Roles of Federal Agencies
discussion_signal: The post summarizes both sides of workplace digital surveillance: it can support safety and identify health problems, but can also increase anxiety or injury risk when productivity targets accelerate work. It connects the GAO review to the question of who should oversee worker-health and control effects.
linked_research_question: When workplace surveillance is justified as safety or productivity infrastructure, how are its health, pace, evaluation, and oversight effects discussed?
limits: Post summarizes a GAO report rather than presenting new evidence
No representative worker discussion sample is captured
The post does not establish net effects across occupations
Public search discovery is not a platform-native Creator/API export
